description: Find recipes on Befana by keywords, ingredients, time or diet. Use when the cook asks "what's for dinner?", "something vegetarian under 30 minutes", "a good banana bread", "something with the spinach I have", or "show me my chili" (mine: true for their own, private ones included). The cook's allergies, diet and avoid list already apply, and their own recipes come first. Returns short summaries with slugs and urls; get_recipe has the full recipe. When the cook names a recipe their preferences hide, it comes back in hidden with why: don't stop to ask; go on with that slug, tell them why it was hidden before anything else, and never present it as safe. Works signed out (public recipes).

exclude_ingredients.description: Extra ingredients to avoid for this search (saved allergies and dislikes already apply)

from_pantry.description: Rank by what the cook has in their saved pantry ("something with pasta from what I have"); each result says what they have and what's missing. For a pure "what can I make?" use suggest_from_pantry

include_ingredients.description: Ingredients the recipe must use, e.g. what is in the fridge

max_calories.description: Calories per serving at most ("under 500 calories"). Defaults to the cook's saved target; recipes whose nutrition can't be fully counted are left out

max_minutes.description: Maximum prep + cook time as the author wrote it (total_minutes). The time range shown (time) is the author's estimate plus a quarter, or the crowd's range once enough cooks finished (time.basis says which), so it can run past the limit

min_protein.description: Grams of protein per serving at least ("high protein": 30). Defaults to the cook's saved target

mine.description: Only the cook's own recipes and versions, including private ones

tags.description: All must match. In use: vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, quick, dinner, breakfast, dessert, baking, soup, side, snack, make-ahead

name: search_recipes

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

hidden.description: Recipes the cook named that their preferences hide; they asked for it, so go on with that slug, warning first

items.description: A recipe the query named that the cook's preferences hide (#99): go on with its slug, warning first

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

why.description: Each reason it was hidden (an allergy, a diet, the avoid list). Tell the cook before anything else

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

no_match.description: Nothing matched the search: recipes is empty and popular holds other picks. Say Befana doesn't have it before offering them

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

popular.description: With no_match: popular recipes the cook can eat, not matches for what they asked

ai_chef.description: True when the cook is an AI chef persona: say so

handle.description: Their profile handle, when they have a public profile

name.description: The credited cook, as shown on the recipe

url.description: Their public profile page, when they have one

mine.description: The cook's own recipe or version

nutrition.description: Nutrition per serving (#244), an estimate; get_recipe has the detail

partial.description: True when an ingredient couldn't be counted: the numbers leave it out. Say what's missing whenever you give a number

per.description: "serving", or one of what the recipe makes ("cookie")

per_serving.description: Per serving, rounded like a label

pantry.description: With from_pantry: what the cook has and what's missing

have.description: Recipe ingredients the cook has (staples assumed)

photo.description: The cover photo's tier: verified, acceptable, needs_work, rejected, or none

photo_is_placeholder.description: True when the cover is a generated illustration of the dish, not a photo: describe it as an illustration

score.description: Overall quality, 0 to 1; ranking input together with relevance. Never carries payment, sponsorship or brand

quality.description: The recipe's quality score, or null when it hasn't been scored

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

basis.description: author: the recipe's own estimate (+25%) until enough cooks finished; cooks: the crowd's range

for_you.description: Minutes for this cook, from their own pace, when they have one

n.description: Finished cooks behind a cooks range; 0 for the author's estimate

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

variation_of.description: Slug of the original when this is a cook's version

visibility.description: Only on the cook's own recipes

why.description: Why it's here, in the cook's words (#60): what it matched (the query, the ingredients asked for) and what lifted it (fits their weeknight time, a cuisine they love, they saved it, well rated, new with few ratings, a Befana pick). Never a brand or a sponsor
